They typically max out at 1,500 watts, or the equivalent of about 5,100 British thermal units (Btu). Most plug into a standard outlet, though some models require a dedicated 220-240V outlet.
 The energy produced by these heaters is infrared, which means it works like direct sunlight and is absorbed straight into your skin and clothes, instead of heating the air around you. [...] The Westinghouse WES31-15110 has only one power setting. Unlike a propane heater (or even our chandelier-style pick above), the Westinghouse has just two modes: on or off. That means there’s no way to get just a little bit of heat — it’s full blast or nothing. This also means that it’s constantly pulling around 1,500 watts of energy, which could add up over time. [...] The infrared waves from the EnerG+ HEA-21288LED heat your skin more quickly, efficiently, and directly. Unlike our propane-powered picks, which warm the air around you, the EnerG+ HEA-21288LED uses infrared to beam warm waves of energy straight into your skin (or whatever else stands in their way).
